newsitem.title: LATVIA: SAVINGS BANK AUCTION PRICE 39.40 LATS.
newsitem.headline: SAVINGS BANK AUCTION PRICE 39.40 LATS.

text.p: The Riga stock exchange said on Monday that Savings Bank's (Krajbanka) auction price was 39.40 lats per share.
One million of the bank's four million shares were auctioned Monday for privatisation vouchers.
"The public offer price of Latvia's Savings Bank (Krajbanka) is a sign of trust in the bank," Arnolds Laksa, the bank's president, told a news conference.
"We have 8,180 new shareholders in addition to the current ones, which makes us the biggest stock company (in Latvia) in terms of owners involved," he added.
Savings Bank's share capital is currently 4.57 million lats with 52 percent in state hands and 25 percent held by individuals and legal entities.
"The result of this auction is a sign of growing activity of individuals participating in the voucher privatisation," Ivars Godmanis, board chairman of Savings Bank, said.
"We will see more of it for Ventspils Nafta, Latvian Gas, and Latvenergo, all which are expected to publicly offered later this year," he said.
